question: Did the 2021 organic framing produce a forced move upmarket?
mechanism: Input prohibition reduced conventional input access before a prepared organic transition existed; subsequent reversal and production losses contradict a simple quality-upgrading pathway.
transmission_channel: import ban through input scarcity into production
scale: Z3 national policy to Z2 tea production
bounded_by: Rejects a sector-wide forced upmarket interpretation, not all organic production.
